_meta.description: Schema for .code-review-refactor-manifest.json — the refactor-review tracking file written and read by `/code-review --refactor` (#3797). Same shape as .code-review-manifest.json, and it never shares state with `.code-review-manifest.json`: a file the standard review approved is still unreviewed for refactoring, and the reverse.

lastRun.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the most recent `/code-review --refactor` invocation that wrote this manifest.

criteria.description: Refactor criteria state at last run — the analog of the standard manifest's `charter`. A mismatch with the current .claude/metadata/refactor-review-criteria.json hash queues every discovered file for re-review.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 hash of refactor-review-criteria.json at last run. Prefixed with 'sha256:'.

files.description: Map from relative file path to per-file refactor-review state. Keys are paths relative to project root.

fileEntry.description: Per-file refactor-review state. Written only for files reviewed in a refactor run — a site the all-files scan found in another file never creates or changes that file's entry.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 hash of file content at last refactor review. Prefixed with 'sha256:'. Mismatch queues the file for re-review.

status.description: Refactor-review status — same values and semantics as the standard manifest: approved = no refactor candidate; flagged = has candidates.

reviewedAt.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the most recent refactor review of this file.

findingCount.description: Count of refactor candidates recorded at last review. 0 when status is 'approved'.

findings.description: Refactor candidates recorded at last review: path, line range, criterion id as category, severity, description, recommendation, and for a wideScan candidate the `sites` the all-files scan found.

issueRefs.description: Issue numbers Step 8 filed from this file's refactor findings through `file-issue.js --manifest .code-review-refactor-manifest.json`.

filingQueue.description: Approved refactor findings awaiting filing — written and rewritten by `file-issue.js --manifest .code-review-refactor-manifest.json`, exactly as in the standard manifest. Optional; absent means nothing queued.

queueItem.description: One approved finding in the filing queue — the standard manifest's queueItem shape.

status.description: `queued` and `failed` are unfiled; `filed` and `updated` are never processed again.

entry.description: The `file-issue.js` entry. A refactor proposal is an `enhancement` whose `Files to modify:` lists every site; a noticed bug is a `bug`.

lastDiffRun.description: The most recent `/code-review --refactor --diff` run, replaced by each such run. Kept here and never in the standard manifest's `lastDiffReview`: a refactor-only pass is not the full review the Release Review Gate requires. Optional.

statusValues.pending: Never refactor-reviewed — queued on next run.
statusValues.approved: Refactor-reviewed with no candidate. Skipped on incremental refactor runs when contentHash matches.
statusValues.flagged: Refactor-reviewed and has candidates. Skipped on incremental refactor runs when contentHash matches.
statusValues.deferred: User skipped this file. Skipped on all incremental refactor runs regardless of hash.

notes: First-run behavior: if .code-review-refactor-manifest.json does not exist, `/code-review --refactor` creates {version: 1, lastRun: <today>, criteria: {contentHash: <current>}, files: {}} and treats every discovered file as new — whatever .code-review-manifest.json says.
Separation: a refactor run never reads statuses from, or writes to, .code-review-manifest.json — in particular it never writes or changes `lastDiffReview` there.
All-files scan: sites found in files not reviewed this run are listed in the proposal; those files' entries are not created or changed.
